questions.stem: This nodal action potential (bold curve) shows a slowed upstroke and prolonged repolarization compared with baseline. Which antiarrhythmic agent produces this effect at the AV node?

explanation.summary: Class IV agents (verapamil, diltiazem) block L-type Ca2+ channels that generate the slow upstroke of nodal action potentials, slowing AV nodal conduction and prolonging repolarization.
explanation.whyCorrect: Class IV agents (verapamil, diltiazem) block L-type Ca2+ channels that generate the slow upstroke of nodal action potentials, slowing AV nodal conduction and prolonging repolarization.
